cycle_cost.basis: 448-record all-reduce (7168 FP32: one TP4 wo_b vector), 4 dies, VM streams one record a cycle; reference = the C8 abstract (engines wired directly: zero link latency, one record a cycle per link)
cycle_cost.decomposition: rate: 0.764 records / cycle per link (reliable-link framing in a 512-b beat) -> 586 vs 448 cycles of transfer (+138); fixed slab pipeline (VM queue, pins, ep TX 2 + gearbox + RX 3 + FIFO, engine, packer, out queue) ~ 190 cycles end to end; at 251-cycle board PHY latency the 256-deep engine FIFO credits (128 / parity / source) make the 448-record transfer wait one credit round trip (~ 2 x 300 cycles) -- the same credit dynamics as the C8 abstract engine at that link latency
cycle_cost.owner_of_model_term: COMPOSE: re-price the TP4 collective with link rate 0.764 rec/cycle (or adopt the optional >= 652-b lane) and the measured fixed pipeline
